nom: Paula's Choice SKIN PERFECTING 2% BHA Liquid Exfoliant

avis.titre: If you actually understand how to use it, it's amazing.
avis.texte: My skin type: - Very Dry, easily dehydrated - Oily nose - Prone to stubborn acne and closed comedones - Redness on chin and cheeks (not rosacea) I already use a nightly Tretinoin cream (.04% concentration) to help with my acne and premature signs of aging but decided with my derm that incorporating a BHA would be a good idea to help with my seriously stubborn closed comedones and some irritating textural issues. It was between this and the Cerave SA lotion and I ultimately decided on this due to the higher concentration of salicylic acid. It's moisturizing, and feels sticky for the first 5-10 minutes after application but seems to sinks in to something of a satin finish on me and I can no longer feel it on my skin. You just have to be a little patient. My skin feels well hydrated and plump after it settles and looks really smooth and my pores aren't as obvious. It sits just fine under makeup for me but I'm not a new user to chemical exfoliants so I don't have lots of dead skin pilling up or sloughing off when I use it, my skin is, for the most part, already very smooth outside the acne and CCs. Occasionally I'll apply it further down my neck/decolletage than usual and WOW do I old skin just ball up and peel right away - it's so gross but also satisfying. So those that don't exfoliate often or are new to BHA/AHAs will likely have issues with foundation until their skin adjusts (but it will adjust). My advice in those cases is to either use this at night for the first few weeks

Let me start by saying I have congested skin, so I know I need an exfoliant. I have used a large number of scrubs, peels, etc. throughout the years and most were bleh. I had become frustrated recently once again with my skin needing help and I saw this item. I decided to try it, and I have used it two nights in a row. Outcome: I could see a significant difference after just the first night. This morning after the second night/application, I still saw an improvement. I am excited that my skin is looking smoother, clearer, and has smaller pores after just two days. I repeat TWO DAYS. I will keep putting it on every night since it does leave a bit of a residue on the skin that I feel I would not like during the day (but maybe it was because I put a lot of it on). Overall, I will continue to use it. And for it being as effective as it is, I don't think it's going to irritate or make my skin red like some other exfoliants have used. But if anything changes I will update my review. Right now, if I could give this 10 stars I would. Also, I feel like this will only help people who have skin that needs exfoliating. If you have decent skin or skin that doesn't need exfoliating, it may not be that amazing nor effective. But it all depends on what your skin needs, so if you have any needs that this product addresses I think you should give it a go. It at least won't harm or irritate your skin. *Disclaimer: I put on a significant amount of this both nights, probably about a good double do

I’ve been using this Paula’s Choice exfoliant for a couple of months now, and it has completely changed the way my skin feels. I’ve tried a lot of facial exfoliants over the years, but this one stands out from everything else I’ve used. What I love most is that it’s both gentle and incredibly effective. It doesn’t leave my face feeling irritated or overly dry, yet I can actually feel it working. I use it once a week, and after each application my skin feels noticeably cleaner, smoother, and refreshed. It seems to clear out my pores better than anything else I’ve tried. The biggest sign that it’s working is that I know exactly when it’s time to use it again. If I go much longer than a week without it, my face starts to feel heavy and congested. After I use it, that feeling is completely gone, and my skin feels light, clean, and renewed. A little goes a long way, so the bottle lasts longer than I expected. I was fortunate enough to catch it on Prime Day and immediately ordered two more bottles so I wouldn’t run out. That’s something I rarely do with skincare products, but this one has earned a permanent place in my routine. If you’re looking for an exfoliant that’s effective without being harsh, I highly recommend giving this one a try. It has made a noticeable difference in the texture and overall feel of my skin, and it’s easily one of the best skincare products I’ve purchased. Five stars without hesitation.

I’ve used quite a few exfoliating products over the years, but I keep coming back to this one because blackheads seem determined to make themselves at home in my pores. No matter how consistent I am with the rest of my skincare routine, they always find a way to show up, especially around my nose and chin. What I like most about this exfoliant is that it works without feeling harsh. It has a lightweight liquid texture that applies easily and absorbs quickly. Unlike physical scrubs that can leave my skin feeling irritated or over-exfoliated, this provides gentle chemical exfoliation with none of the rough scrubbing. My skin feels smoother after use, and I don’t get the tight, stripped feeling that some acne-focused products can cause. After using it regularly, I notice fewer clogged pores and a visible reduction in blackheads. My pores also look less noticeable, and my skin texture appears more even overall. It helps keep congestion under control before it turns into larger blemishes, which is a big reason why it has remained a staple in my routine. For me, this is one of those rare products that manages to be both effective and gentle at the same time. If blackheads and clogged pores are an ongoing battle, this has been one of the most reliable products I’ve found for keeping them under control while still being comfortable enough for regular use. Summary: This exfoliant has earned a permanent spot in my skincare routine. It helps reduce blackheads, keeps my pores looking cle

avis.titre: The strongest, yet most gentle product I have ever experienced!
avis.texte: I have used products that are either too weak to notice any difference or so strong that my skin peels so badly that I'm embarrassed to leave my home. Paula's liquid exfoliant is absolutely amazing! It goes on like water and my initial impression was that it would do nothing. In fact, after my first (and literally every application since), I've been shocked at the improvement in my skin. Last week, I ran out of Paula's and decided to use my old tretinoin before bed. The next morning, my skin was coming off like a snake's skin in layers! It was so embarrassing that I actually called in sick to work, because my skin looked so horrible! I immediately ordered more of Paula's exfoliant. I had yet to venture out of my home, as my skin was coming off in literal sheets! And my face itched! If I scratched it, my skin would flake off like the worst dandruff anyone had ever seen. I was so embarrassed that I called in sick again that day. Thankfully, the Paula's exfoliation liquid came in that afternoon. I immediately applied it, and I reapplied it before bed that night. The following morning, my skin looked perfect! No more flaking or peeling off in sheets. No more itching. Paula's Skin Perfecting Exfoliant is both incredibly gentle and incredibly powerful! I honestly don't know how it can be so perfectly both gentle and powerful, but I will never go without it again. In fact, I'm buying it again today because of Prime Day and it's on sale. avis.titre: Noticeable improvement in pore size-would purchase again.
avis.texte: Purchased smallest bottle . Works better than anticipated. Have had issues with nose and chin pore size and accompanying blackheads for decades. Previous products (tried many) overly dried my skin and did zero to shrink pores. Have used for one week and can see a noticeable difference, particularly on my nose. Smaller pores and smooth skin! Happy with usage results, though deducted one star for bottle top design. Semi-difficult to get product out of the container. Found that using a Q-tip and pressing directly against opening has given the best results. Will likely repurchase.

I was skeptical at first, because oftentimes something that’s so heavily praised online does not live up to the expectations. For about 3 days of constant use (my skin tolerates it) I didn’t see any effect and it slowly started to reinforce the initial skepticism. However, all has changed on day 4. When I was washing my face with water, I noticed that some white stuff comes off my skin in the areas where I’ve been applying this exfoliant. That’s how I knew it was definitely working. The texture is also very pleasant, it feels like water – not greasy, not heavy, and absorbs quickly. So far it seems like it might be my new “holy grail” as well.

avis.titre: Not for me, but maybe okay for others
avis.texte: I preface this with saying that my comments are about how this product was for me, and it may work differently or wonderfully for someone else. I was a user of a product called "The Ordinary", and that product was the same (2%) as this one, but more like a serum. I tried this one based on the reviews. I dislike the bottle and the way the product comes out. It's a thinner liquid, and can be messy. You do have to pour it into your hand, and work it onto your face from there, so some product gets wasted. I did not find this product to me more remarkable than the other I used, and I've given it a fair shot (months of using). I wrote the manufacturer about the packaging, and they responded politely. I don't think it will change though unless others say something. I'll finish this bottle since I paid for it, and will go back to the other product, as the serum is placed on my skin with a dropper, and is not messy or wasted. Hopefully others have a better experience.
Llevo años usando este producto porque me ayuda a controlar mis espinillas ocasionales. Mantiene los poros limpios y se notan menos. No podría estar sin él
Love this , it really works, skin became much prettier! Will buy again 👍

I love this exfoliator! It’s great for when my skin feels congested after a few days of wearing makeup, I use it around 2 times a week and over time it’s really helped my skin feel smoother and have less blemishes. I bought a mini one to take when I travel or stay at my partners, this is really useful!

Amazing product! The progress with this takes a few months ...but please be patient! At 33 years old I never thought I’d be free from breakouts and scarring from cystic hormonal type acne. Started using once a day on a cotton pad at night. Skin will sting a tad & be slightly flaky to start after a few days. Skin may “purge” spots as pores are unclogged but this will calm down - trust me! Once skin becomes flaky I then reduced to use all over my face every 3 days, but everyday along my jawline and neck. I follow with a light oil free moisturiser. Honestly, I have used around 2 bottles in 8 months and I get minimal spots now, and they heal very quickly. Any inflammation comes up and I pop a dab of this on! Skin also feels so smooth too. This is a real review!!! It could change your life!!

De los mejores exfoliantes que he probado. La textura es súper ligera y cuando te lo pones la piel lo absorbe rapidísimo, dejando una capa muy ligera que hace que la piel se sienta súper suave. Pero el verdadero cambio se nota después de un rato, cuando ves la piel mucho más limpia y con una textura muchísimo más bonita. De verdad me sorprendió muchísimo este producto.

avis.titre: Parece magia para poros tapados y pieles grasas 💗
avis.texte: Soy adolescente por lo tanto mi rostro es más sensible y mi piel es grasa, me molestaba que siempre tenía pequeñas imperfecciones en la nariz y frente, ademas de demasiados puntos negros. Se solucionó totalmente, me pongo unas gotas en las zonas que mencioné y tres minutos después aplico mi crema hidratante. Los poros tapados desaparecen como magia. Lo hago dos veces por semana aunque el empaque indica que debe ser dos veces por día, me da pereza la verdad, pero voy a intentarlo más seguido porque los resultados son increíbles, yo lo aplico con mis dedos y en un segundo parece que la piel ya lo absorbió, es muy rápido. Junto con mi protector solar contribuyó a igualar el tono de mi piel. Antes de comprarlo pensé que era muy fuerte pero no me ha causado irritación, ni siquiera un cosquilleo. Investigue el producto en tik tok cuando estaba decidiendo; muchas chicas decían que causaba brotes de acné antes de lograr resultados….pero es mentira, si usas la cantidad correcta como en mi caso, hace que tu piel mejore. Hay que decir que es bastante caro, lo compre en descuento. Si no puedes gastar tanto dinero recomiendo buscar otras opciones aunque sin duda vale la pena. SÚPER RECOMENDADO!!! (Recuerda usar protector solar)

Este es de esos productos que tenía muchas ganas de probar porque escuchaba maravillas de él. Lo estoy incorporando poco a poco a mi rutina y me gusta que no tengo que tallar ni maltratar mi piel para exfoliarla. Su ácido salicílico trabaja directamente en los poros, ayudando con los puntitos negros, la textura y el exceso de grasa. Mi objetivo con él: una piel más limpia, lisa y uniforme.

I rarely write reviews because I don’t come across a lot of products that I am blown away. But if you can tell by my comparison photo, I’ve made PRETTY DRASTIC improvements with my skin within a month! So I had to share my thoughts and experiences! I used the product every night before bed with a cotton ball for about a month now. To give you some background, I played college tennis 10 years ago. I was out in the sun all the time for practice. I have hyperpigmentation, large pores, oily face, fungal acne/bumps, and acne scars. Ive had it all. I also hated putting on sunscreen back then because I hate the oily texture of sunscreen with sweat mixed together so I was taking in UVA/UVB at full strength with beaming rays in warm SoCal sun for many many years. Fast forward 10 years, I’ve been pretty religious with skincare since graduating college because I realized that I’ve done huge damage to my skin. I made progress during those 10 years with consistency, but there were still some room for improvements as you can see in the photo. With age, I started seeing some wrinkles under my eyes and and on my forehead as well. I started getting all serious about skincare again a month ago by revisiting my usual selections to see what I can introduce into my routine. I found this product on YouTube, some blog post, and then Amazon. Decided to take a stab with the huge amount of reviews. BEST DECISION EVER! I saw changes within a few days of use! Skin started getting smoother and then pores
I haven't used it yet i will come back on that after I few days. I m just little disappointed because of the size of the bottle i received. I wasn't expecting this 😄

applied the night before an important event and woke up with glass skin. treat whenever annoying milias (clogged pores) shows up :) remember to not use daily though! will most definitely invest in a bigger bottle next purchase

avis.titre: sebaceous glands cannot be fully gone but this product has truly helped diminish their appearance
avis.texte: This product has helped my skin so much! I was skeptical at first because I know my sebaceous glands cannot be fully gone but, this product has truly helped diminish their appearance. I use it twice a week to ensure I don’t dry my skin out too much and I also moisturize about 15 minutes after to cut down on any dryness. My main concern area was my cheeks and my nose, and as you can see from my before and after photos, it has made my pores much less visible. If you’re looking for a cheap alternative to some of the more expensive spa treatments, I would highly recommend this 2% BHA exfoliate.
Bottle is very small formulated at an optimal pH of 3.2–3.8 it provides effective exfoliation without added alcohol, parabens, or synthetic fragrance.
Great product, very small but since I have been using I have notice a great difference in my face! Not much breakout or pimples!

avis.titre: Results Take Time, But It Works!!
avis.texte: I’ve been using Paula’s Choice 2% BHA Exfoliant for a while now, and it’s become a staple in my skincare routine. The first few times I used it, it felt a little strong on my skin, but that sensation faded as my skin adjusted. What I like most is that it has helped clear up both my acne and the marks left behind from previous breakouts. My skin looks smoother, and clogged pores are much less of an issue now. The key is consistency. This isn’t an overnight miracle product, but if you use it regularly and give it time, you’ll start to see the results. Be patient, stick with it, and your skin will thank you.

I do not say this lightly, this exfoliant completely transformed my skin. I have struggled with clogged pores and stubborn blackheads for years. I tried scrubs, masks, pore strips, expensive treatments, and nothing delivered lasting results. Within the first week of using Paula's Choice Face Exfoliant 2% BHA Liquid Salicylic Acid Facial Exfoliator for Blackhead, I saw a visible difference. My pores looked clearer. My skin felt smoother. That rough congested texture along my nose and chin started fading fast. What makes this product magical is the texture. It looks like water, feels like nothing, and absorbs instantly. No greasy film. No sticky residue. No heavy fragrance cloud. Just clean, simple, effective skincare. I apply it with my hands after cleansing and let it sink in. There is a slight tingle at first, which reassured me it was getting to work deep inside my pores. And it truly works deep. Salicylic acid is oil soluble, so it penetrates into the pore lining and dissolves the buildup that causes blackheads and congestion. Instead of aggressively scrubbing the surface, this gently clears from within. After two weeks my blackheads were dramatically reduced. After a month they were barely noticeable. My makeup applies more smoothly now because my skin surface is refined and even. Another unexpected benefit was how balanced my skin became. I used to get random breakouts around my T zone. Since incorporating this exfoliant into my routine, those surprise blemishes are rare

avis.titre: Liquid goldddd!!! (FYI Photos do not have filters)
avis.texte: I always suffer from Hormonal/cystic acne since I was in middle school (I’m 22) . Pimples that are under the skin with no head so it takes weeks to disappear but leave hyperpigmentation. I cry a lot of how it hurts and my self esteem was so low . I used curology to cure the acne but then I needed to target the hyperpigmentation . That’s when I discovered Paula’s choice bha . I’ve been using it for over a year now . I’m on my 4-5th bottle . I tried others like glow recipe or versed . It wasn’t showing improvement as fast as I wanted if I ran out and wanted to try something different . If I can’t make it to Sephora I order it on Amazon . I barely break out that much . When I do have 1-2 pimples show up. They usually disappear within a week when I use it . I recommended to all of my family and friends that range of all skin types . My cousin has dry acne prone . She said her skin felt better within a week . She usually has flaky skin around her nose . I love that they offer travel size . I keep the small one just in case if I need to travel/spend the night . It’s easy to take the plastic thing off with tweezers. Usually it last me 4 months (using it everyday) so I think I get my money’s worth if I don’t have to replenish every month and it works . If anyone is interested in my skin regimen in order (remember not all skin is the same) : cerave SA Paula’s choice BHA Acne free terminator 10 spot treatment Laneige cream skin toner Bubble vitamin c & Niacinamide Miss A invisible acne

This was my first time buying and using Paula’s Choice toner, and I’m very impressed with the results. I have large pores, and after adding this toner to my skincare routine, I noticed that my pores look much smaller. It has made a huge difference in how my makeup applies—my foundation looks more like natural skin and goes on much smoother. The toner is lightweight, absorbs quickly, and doesn’t feel heavy or greasy. I use it every other day, mostly at night, and it has become a must-have in my nighttime skincare routine. If you’re looking for a product that helps minimize the appearance of pores and creates a smoother base for makeup, I highly recommend giving this toner a try. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I was starting to get bad hormonal acne on my chin. Start off as skin color nodules that turn into massive red pimples that I've never had before. Does not help my work requires wearing a mask as well. I have tried multiple products and I was tired of taking doxycycline every single day for years in order to get rid of everything. I even had prescription retinol creams. I bought Paula's Choice due to the reviews and hype. Not expecting much, but I started using it morning and night after washing my face with my normal moisturizing face wash. I would then follow up with a moisturizer for the face accepted by the eczema foundation. Both the face wash and moisturizer have been in my routine for months. The only step I changed was using Paula's Choice in the middle. This routine has cleared up my skin in just a week of use every morning and night. My skin looks brighter, smoother, and more uniformed. I look in the mirror and feel like I look younger. My boyfriend even commented positively on my skin as well. I have never been more impressed by an over the counter product for my face. Is it expensive? Yes Does it last long? It can. I use about 4 drops per use for a week and I feel like I hardly touched it. Does it work? Look at my photo!!! 100% yes from me Would I buy it again? YES YES YES

avis.titre: It's good, except that it's very small.
avis.texte: I didn't realize it was so small, but it's a very good product; it cleans pores very well and is gentle. If you have blemishes or pitted areas on your face, you might want to give it a try.

avis.titre: Just be careful how frequently you're using it if you're new to skin care!
avis.texte: This is an updated review. First time I used it my skin felt a burning sensation almost immediately afterwards. I thought I wasn't going to use it again. But then I did some research. Even though the back of the bottle says you can use it up to twice a day I have found that only twice weekly is about what I can tolerate. This is along with daily vitamin c in the morning as well as twice daily snail mucin and moisturizer. And retinol on alternating nights three nights a week. I was originally very cautious and only used an exfoliant once a week. I slowly moved up to the point of using it almost every other night. Apparently, that can be too much for some people. I ended up taking a break and now I can safely and comfortably use this product. It's got such rave reviews all over the place. And I do feel like it is actually shrinking my pores. I'm not giving it 5 stars, because I don't think they should suggest using it up to twice a day without a little bit of a warning. And I do suggest applying with a cotton pad. I don't think you waste a lot of product. My skin feels like it's burning which started about 20 minutes after application and is still burning 2 hours later.

avis.titre: GET THIS NOW! BEST FOR ACNE PRONE SKIN
avis.texte: Hands down the best treatment for ACNE. I have bad cystic acne during my cycle, and it would take me weeks for it to go away. I started using this back in November 2025 and gradually introduced it to my skin. I still use it every other day to avoid stressing my skin. I do it on Mondays and Wednesdays and Saturdays. I am glad to say that my skin is looking so much better! I don’t get cystic anymore, just a few pimples here and there but nothing that cannot be managed. My black bottle is finished, and I went with the “Clear Extra Strength” as it has the same ingredients and is FSA eligible this year! I would highly recommend anyone struggling with Acne. Make sure you introduce this gradually and moisturize well. WIN for my skin!

avis.titre: It works. But it depends on your skin type how fast you'll see results.
avis.texte: Works ok.. I read reviews before I bought and it really sounded like it would fix my problems. But I guess everyone's skin is different. It does work. But maybe it takes a little longer for some people. Fingers crossed I see more visible improvements.

This is my own fault and shame on me for not looking at the size, but I was very disappointed when it showed up miniature. For $12 I was really hoping for a bit more product. I’m hoping it’s going to stretch far. As for the efficacy, I can’t speak that much on it since today is the first time I’m using it.

I absolutely love this product! At first I was just putting the product on a cotton pad and using it in replace of a toner, definitely not the way to go. I wasn’t seeing any results even after a month so I got back on the reviews and read a few to see if I could figure out a better routine. I use this after washing my face. Occasionally I will wash my face and then use a facial steamer and then apply this. I would recommend not using a cotton pad to apply. I put this in the palm of my hand and evenly distribute it all over my face and neck. You don’t want too thin/thick of a layer. LET IT DRY before you put any products on top. I usually apply this and find something to do for 5-10 mins to give it time to dry down. Once it’s completely dry I put my serum on, let that soak in and apply moisturizer. If it’s morning I will use one with spf in it, at night I typically use a thicker more heavy moisturizer. This will definitely make your skin purge, so be mindful of that. I would say it took a good 3-4 weeks before my skin looked good. I broke out pretty bad in my chin the first week or so. The following week my skin had a lot of flakiness (which made it near impossible to apply foundation). The last week I had two horrible breakouts, one in the middle of my forehead and the other in the side of my face. So bad to the point where I was wearing pimple patches at work for two days because that made it look better, it was very noticeable. I tried to keep from covering it with makeup j

avis.titre: Paula's Choice Skin Perfecting 2% BHA Liquid Salicylic Acid
avis.texte: Works really well, but it’s strong. I’d recommend using it carefully, about once a week or as advised by your dermatologist.

avis.titre: Not a miracle, but still pretty great!
avis.texte: A lot of people say that this is their miracle or holy grail product so I had high hopes that it would be the same for me. My skin type is combination with dry cheecks and an oily T-zone but large pores *everywhere*. They always appear large and the pores on my nose always look clogged. I bought this after hearing all of the rave reviews that said it made their pores shrink and eliminated their blackheads. I've used this about 2-3 times per week since the day it arrived (on June 24th) and I'm just about to finish it this week (today is November 8th). I will say that this lasted me waaaaay longer than I expected! I will note that my product came sealed in plastic, but it seemed as if a bit of product had leaked out of the bottle into the plastic. When I opened it up, the bottle was still plugged up with the stopper and it didn't seem like much had leaked out so it wasn't a huge deal for me. I applied the product at night only to avoid sun damage and I used my hands to apply instead of a cotton ball (which I feel just wastes the product). It can feel oily initially after you put it on, but if you applied the correct amount then the feeling should go away after a few minutes. When I used this product at night, I did notice that it cleaned the sebum out of my pores almost immediately. When I woke up in the morning my pores would look unclogged for the most part as well, which tends to make them look a tad bit smaller. When I say that my pores were "unclogged for the most part" in

You want to know what really grinds my gears? When a customer posts a review that has a picture of the bottle and nothing else. Unless the bottle was not delivered in tact, who does this serve? You’re reading reviews to see how this product will effect your skin, not to see a picture of the bottle. Be more helpful. The “day 3” picture was taken 10/05/23 at night. I’m just shy of 38 if that helps. The other picture was taken 11/08/23 in the morning. The difference in my skin tone is the morning light and my sunscreen. Otherwise no filters. With the exception of a few nights, I’ve been using this product nightly. I notice that my milia under my eye are softer and less clumped together so I think it’s working? However, I have noticed that if I use this BHA product and get my versed moisturizer or smooth landing eye balm in the same area, my skin reacts (swells, turns a weird brown color). So be warned about using it with other skin care products. On its own, it’s been pretty gentle. But that is frustrating that a product I use at night around my eyes limits other products that are recommended to be used at night for my eyes. I guess pick your battles?

avis.titre: 📉 Shrunk My Pores Without Shredding My Face
avis.texte: I’ve tried a lot of exfoliants over the years, but this is the only one that actually did something without wrecking my moisture barrier. Within a few nights, the little bumps on my chin were smoother and the clogged pores around my nose didn’t look so stubborn. It’s strong, but not mean 💪 🧖‍♀️ Beginner Tip: Use it just once or twice a week at night, no more. Apply it after cleansing 🧼 wait a minute or two, then follow with a good moisturizer. If your skin’s dry or easily irritated, layering hyaluronic acid underneath helps soften the blow without watering it down 💧 I like pairing it with niacinamide or HA serum and sealing everything in with a barrier-loving moisturizer. On dry skin nights, I’ll top it with rosehip oil. The combo leaves my face looking smoother, calmer, and somehow less oily by morning 🌙 ✨ I used to think exfoliants were all hype, but this one made me believe in the process again. What makes Paula’s Choice better than the rest? No gimmicks, no scrubbing beads, and no overpowering actives that leave your face stinging for hours. It’s just a clean, proven formula with salicylic acid that gets deep into pores without picking a fight with your skin 🫧 And it plays nicely with the rest of your routine, no mystery reactions, no weird residue. Fragrance-free, no stickiness, and the bottle lasts forever 🧴 Still not a miracle product, but it doesn’t pretend to be. Just something that actually works ✅
Excellent chemical exfoliant and product I would probably buy this again in the future it feels really good on the skin and can definitely help with black dots in the nose and other skin parts

This exfoliant definitely gives me that dewy, just-woke-up-like-this glow by morning. That said, it’s on the stronger side for my combination skin. I learned quickly that following it up with a nighttime cream is non-negotiable. Whenever I skipped the moisturizer, there was a noticeable stinging sensation that lasted for a few minutes. After about a month of consistent use, my skin did look brighter and more even, which I loved. I started cautiously at twice a week, and worked my way up to every other day. If your skin leans sensitive, or combination like mine, ease in slowly and moisturize well.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Really happy with this product! It feels nice on my skin, absorbs well, and leaves my skin feeling fresh, soft, and comfortable. The quality is great, and I’m very happy with the results so far. Definitely worth trying!

avis.titre: Effective but gentle — even with sensitive, psoriasis-prone skin
avis.texte: I have very sensitive skin and psoriasis, so I have to be extremely careful with exfoliants. Most are either too harsh or trigger irritation. Paula’s Choice 2% BHA Liquid has been surprisingly well-tolerated for me. I use it 2–3 times a week, not daily. That frequency is enough to keep my pores clear, improve texture, and reduce occasional breakouts without compromising my skin barrier. It smooths my skin without causing flaking, burning, or redness — which is rare for an acid product on my skin. If you have sensitive or reactive skin, this isn’t something I’d overuse. Start slow. But used strategically, it’s effective and balanced. For me, it’s one of the few chemical exfoliants that delivers results without triggering a flare. Photos of before and after — black top is before and the blush/pink is a photo after.
